title: Symphonic Études - No. 9
notable_excerpt: Key: c# minor. Chord journey: bVI - bVII - v5 - bVI7 - bVI - bVII - i7 - i4 - bVII4/2 - v - bii6 - #iiio - V6 - bVII - i - bVII, closing on I7. Texture: rising bass steps under thick chordal figuration.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #289811 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1887), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~97%, pitch ~92% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op13_symphonic_etudes_9.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Symphonic Études Op. 13. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
